store.description: The original bird-flinging puzzler, playable straight from the Internet Archive. Pull back the slingshot, read the tower and knock every pig out with the right angle and the right bird.
features: Classic slingshot physics: aim, pull, release
Dozens of levels of pig-fort demolition
Playable in the browser via the Internet Archive's emulator
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
